name: Evenicle 2
source:
There is an illness spreading through the world called the 'Hero Syndrome' where using magic will result in early death. People skilled in combat fought with monsters aware of their shortening lifespan. They fought to eliminate as many monsters as possible to protect their families and friends.

In this tragic world appeared a young man, Alex, who was blessed with a legendary healing ability. His body fluids can cure any ailment without physical trauma. He set out to save the girls suffering from the 'Hero Syndrome'.

[Edited & taken from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/02/21/february-2019-eroge-releases//]Omochikaeri blog[/url] and [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015075.html/?locale=en_US]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
有一种疾病正在全世界蔓延，称为“英雄综合症”，使用魔法会导致早死。擅长战斗的人们与怪物战斗，意识到它们的寿命正在缩短。他们努力消灭尽可能多的怪物，以保护家人和朋友。

在这个悲惨的世界中出现了一位年轻人，亚历克斯，他被赋予了传奇般的治愈能力。他的体液可以治愈任何疾病，并且不会造成身体伤害。他着手拯救患有“英雄综合症”的女孩们。

[编辑并取自 [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2019/02/21/february-2019-eroge-releases//]Omochikaeri博客[/url] 和 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015075.html/?locale=en_US]English DLsite[/url]]
